data.name: Bhanuprasad
data.long_meaning: The name Bhanuprasad is a combination of two words - Bhanu and Prasad. Bhanu is a name of the Sun God, while Prasad means blessing. Therefore, Bhanuprasad means 'the blessing of Lord Bhanu'. This name is often given to a child born on a Sunday, as the Sun is the ruling planet of this day.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the blessings and protection of the Sun God.
